title: Inner Sunset vs Mission for a runner without a car

entries.query_str: moving to sf in august, no car, i run a lot. inner sunset vs mission vs somewhere else? budget ~1800 for a room
entries.answer:
For a runner without a car, the main trade-offs are **park access, fog/weather, and transit** [1][2]:

**Inner Sunset**
- Next to **Golden Gate Park** — miles of soft-surface and paved loops, easy long runs to Ocean Beach [1].
- Foggier and cooler, especially in summer; quieter, more residential.
- N-Judah light rail downtown; slower to the east side of the city.
- Rooms at your budget are common in shared flats [2].

**Mission**
- Sunniest, warmest neighborhood; lots of food and nightlife.
- **Dolores Park** is close but small; longer runs mean heading to the Embarcadero or up to Twin Peaks (hilly) [1].
- Best transit hub: BART plus several Muni lines — good if you commute to SoMa or the East Bay.
- Rooms around $1,600–2,000 are typical, often in older flats [2].

**Also consider:** **Inner Richmond** (north side of GGP, similar to Inner Sunset, slightly cheaper), **Cole Valley/Haight** (between GGP and transit), and **Marina/Cow Hollow** (flat waterfront running to the Golden Gate Bridge, but pricier) [2][3].

If running is your top priority, Inner Sunset or Inner Richmond is the strongest pick.

entries.query_str: im going to be in a house in soma-ish area actually (incubator) for the first months. where do people run from there
entries.answer:
From SoMa the go-to options are [1][2]:
- **Embarcadero waterfront** — flat, out-and-back north past the Ferry Building toward Fort Mason/Crissy Field; 10–20 km easily.
- **Mission Creek / China Basin paths** — short loops near the ballpark.
- **Crissy Field to the Golden Gate Bridge** — the classic long run; ~8 km each way from the Ferry Building.
- Weekends: Muni to **Golden Gate Park** for soft surfaces.

entries.query_str: how bad is the fog for running in august
entries.answer: August is peak fog season on the west side (Sunset, Richmond, Ocean Beach): mornings are often gray, windy and ~13–16 °C [1]. The east side (SoMa, Mission, Embarcadero) clears more often by late morning. For running it's actually pleasant — cool and humid — just bring a light layer and expect wind on the waterfront [1].
